STEP 1 - Scene: A salad bowl (chicken, avocado, spinach, shredded cheese, carrot, dark beans/olives) photographed from above at a near-overhead angle.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White bowl roughly 22 cm across (cereal-bowl-to-side-plate size, the rim is roughly 2.2x a typical 10 cm fork width). Radius 11 cm, area = 3.14 x 11^2 ≈ 380 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: baby spinach leaves, diced grilled chicken, avocado chunks, shredded hard cheese (Parmesan-style), shredded carrot, dark red kidney beans/beans. No visible dressing pool.

STEP 4 - Area (percent of bowl covering food, total ~90%):
- Spinach leaves 25% = 95 cm^2 x 2 cm = 190 ml x 0.15 = 29 g x 23 kcal/100g = 7 kcal
- Chicken pieces 20% = 76 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 114 ml x 1.0 = 114 g x 165 kcal = 188 kcal
- Avocado 15% = 57 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 86 ml x 0.6 = 51 g x 160 kcal = 82 kcal
- Shredded cheese 15% = 57 cm^2 x 1 cm = 57 ml x 0.9 = 51 g x 400 kcal = 205 kcal
- Kidney beans 8% = 30 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 46 ml x 0.9 = 41 g x 127 kcal = 52 kcal
- Carrot shreds 4% = 15 cm^2 x 1 cm = 15 ml x 0.6 = 9 g x 41 kcal = 4 kcal
- Remaining ~3% bare bowl/gaps, no food counted.

STEP 5-6 - Totals: about 340 g of food.

STEP 7 - Energy: about 538 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A full, heaped salad bowl with a chicken and cheese topping at roughly 340 g and about 540 kcal is plausible; the spinach is light, so most weight comes from chicken and cheese.
